policy placement_group_1: target lb_web removed with its node
request_description: This architecture includes a load balancer routing traffic to a web application hosted on an Nginx web server. The web server runs on a scalable virtual machine in the us-east-1 region. Two additional virtual machines (VM-A and VM-B) are deployed in us-east-1 and eu-west-2 regions, respectively. The load balancer uses a layer4 algorithm and a cloud-provider-managed IP address dynamically associated with all instances of the virtual machine hosting the web application.
